sn2.25:1.1: Evaṃ me sutam ekaṃ samayaṃ sambahulā bhikkhū Kosalesu viharanti Himavanta-passe araññakuṭikāyaṃ uddhatā unnaḷā capalā mukharā vikiṇṇavācā muṭṭhassatino asampajānā asamāhitā vibbhatacittā pākatindriyā || ||
sn2.25:2.1: Atha kho Jantu devaputto tadahuposathe pannarase yena te bhikkhū ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā te bhikkhū gāthāhi ajjhabhāsi || ||
sn2.25:3.1: Sukhajīvino pure āsuṃ || bhikkhū Gotama-sāvakā || anicchā piṇḍam esanā || anicchā sayanāsanaṃ || loke aniccataṃ ñatvā || dukkhass-antam akaṃsu te || ||
sn2.25:4.1: Dupposaṃ katvā attānaṃ || gāme gāmaṇikā viya || bhutvā bhutvā nipajjanti || parāgāresu mucchitā ||
sn2.25:5.1: saṅghassa añjaliṃ katvā || idh-ekacce vandām-aham || || Apaviddhā anāthā te || yathā petā tath-eva te ||
sn2.25:6.1: ye kho pamattā viharanti || te me sandhāya bhāsitaṃ || ye appamattā viharanti || namo tesam karom-ahan ti || ||
